source_plans: .handover/artifacts/external-adapter-benchmark-plan-v1.md (stryker_serial arm only; external_gate and native_kernel arms excluded from this decision entirely, not deferred)
benchmarks/fixture-faults/README.md (36/36 proven fault operators, the frozen V3 oracle this item measures against)

component_under_test.hypothesis: A general-purpose mutation tool (StrykerJS) catches at least one causally valid, behaviorally distinct fault that this repo's own targeted V2/V3 fault injection misses, at reasonable cost.
component_under_test.already_decided: Raw mutation score is not product quality and is never reported as one. StrykerJS is not a dependency and is not built into e2e-skills regardless of this result -- the only open question is the narrower adjunct-coverage one above.

measures: invalid_or_infra_failure_rate (automatic REJECT above a preregistered threshold, never a smaller sample)
wall_time_and_cpu_cost_local_only (no model calls anywhere in this protocol)

evaluated_snapshot.policy: Digests below are recorded at preparation time from git HEAD 90b1d4088d63df623cee4be9bfd2543a41d8b210 (tag v1.16.0); every listed file was verified byte-identical to that HEAD when recorded. They MUST be recomputed at freeze into freeze-record.json together with the model-free tool identity (Stryker version, install method) and the unfaulted-native-stability check. This file is never edited after freeze.
evaluated_snapshot.note: This protocol touches zero skills/*/SKILL.md, playwright-agents.md, pattern-reference.md, agents/*.md, or .codex/agents/*.toml files -- no model call, no skill invocation, no generator/reviewer/debugger/healer/planner arm anywhere in this design. It therefore places no sha256 hold on any of those files and does not compete with healer-perturbation-v1 or subagent-routing-v1 for the same pinned surface.

targets.primary: scripts/evals/fixtures/playwright (this repo's own fixture app; the 12-operator, 36/36-proven V3 fault catalog in benchmarks/fixture-faults/ is the frozen oracle of behaviorally relevant fault)
targets.secondary_optional: one second, small, fresh application chosen the same way item 1/6 select fresh targets (freshness-exclusion search recorded before selection), used only if the primary target's result is ambiguous or the operator wants a cross-app signal

stryker_serial.tool: StrykerJS, disposable install, never added to any target's own package.json/lockfile

procedure: 1. Unfaulted native run of the fixture app's Playwright suite, 3 repetitions; abort if not stable 3/3.
2. Freeze and hash the V3 fault manifest (benchmarks/fixture-faults/2026-07-31-current.json) BEFORE any Stryker output is inspected.
3. Dry-run Stryker first (no mutation execution) to validate config against the frozen source tree.
4. Real run: concurrency 1, incremental mode off.

5. Required control cells: no-op-copy (identical source, must not report any kill), positive-control (a known-killable seeded mutant, must report killed), irrelevant-fault-control (a mutant outside any user-visible behavior, must not be counted toward the verdict even if reported killed).
6. Source fingerprint (sha256 of the whole fixture tree) compared before and after every Stryker invocation; any drift aborts the run.
7. A process exit code alone is never counted as a kill -- the failure must reach the primary assertion of a real test, verified per survivor/kill the same way V2/V3 verifies causality.

decision_rule.optional_adapter: Only if, on every target run (primary, and secondary if used), within the preregistered budget below, Stryker finds at least one causally valid, behaviorally distinct survivor/kill not already present in the frozen V3 manifest.
decision_rule.reference_only: Default outcome otherwise -- no adjunct value demonstrated beyond what V2/V3 already covers.
decision_rule.reject: Automatic if the invalid/infra-failure rate exceeds the preregistered threshold (TBD at freeze). A REJECT is never rescued by a smaller sample.

cost_ceiling.note: Local CPU only. Naive estimate and hard ceiling for wall-clock/CPU time are TBD at freeze -- Stryker's real per-mutant runtime on this fixture app has never been measured, unlike the top-level-agent-session estimates used in item 1/3/6.
cost_ceiling.pause_and_ask_at: TBD at freeze (2x of the freeze-time naive estimate, matching the multiplier convention used by item 1/3/6)

Whether the secondary/fresh target is used at all, and if so, which one (freshness-exclusion search not yet run).
